chapter.verse: Jesu Khris' sila leh sawltak khat ahi keimah Simeon Peter in, i Pasian leh Honpa Jesu Khris' dikna thu hangin komau' upna tawh a manphatzah a kibang upna nam a ngah khinsate kong hopih hi.
Pasian leh Jesu i Topa theihna cingtaak tawh note' tungah hehpihna leh nopna lemna a tampi hong om ta hen.
Pasian in ama' minpha leh hoihna phatna tungtawnin eite hong samkhia a, amah i theihna cingtaak tungtawnin ama' vangliatna in nuntakna leh biakna lungsim lamsang i kisap khempeuh hong guan khin hi.

Tua bangin a manpha leh a thupi mahmah kamciamte hong guatna a hang pen cilesa lunggulhna huhau-a a piang, leitunga om muattheihna thu tawh note kipelhin Pasian' pianngeizia sungah kihelte na suah nading uh ahi hi.
Hih thu hang mahin hihtheihtawp hahkatin na upna uh hoihna phatna tawh behlap unla hoihna phatna pen thutheihna tawh,
thutheihna pen pumpi ki-ukzawhna tawh, pumpi ki-ukzawhna pen thuakzawhna tawh, thuakzawhna pen biakna lungsim tawh,
biakna lungsim pen sanggam ki-itna tawh, sanggam ki-itna pen itna tawh, na behlap toto un.
A hang pen hihte no' a suaksakin na khansak uhleh tuate in note a thadah, kimanna neilo na hihloh nadingun hong kem ding a, i Topa Jesu Khris theihna cingtaak hong neisak ding hi.
A hang pen hihte a neilo peuhpeuh khuamuhna a toi, khuamulo mi hi a, a mawhna luite pan amah kisawpsiang khin ahihlam a mangngilh ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin sanggamte aw, note hong kisapkhiatna leh hong kiteelkhiatna thu a telcian na hih nadingun hihtheihtawp hanciam un. A hang pen tua bangin na hih uhleh na puk ngeikei ding uh hi.
Tua hi a, Jesu Khris i Topa leh Honpa' tawntung kumpigam sung lut theihna thu, hih bang danin note' tungah a kicingin hong kipia ding hi.
Tua ahih manin hih thute a theitel, tu-a na neih uh thumaan thutak sungah zong a kilamkip, na hih uh hangin hih thute phawnkik kong sawm den hi.
Hih ka tenna buk sungah ka om laiteng phawksakna nam tawh note kong phawn ding hoih hi ci-in ka ngaihsun hi.
A hang pen i Topa Jesu Khris in teltak hong lah mah bangin ka tenna buk a kihepkhiat ding hun hong nai ta cih ka thei hi.
Kei' paikhiat nungah a hun simin hih thute na phawkkik theih nadingun hihtheihtawp ka hanciam ding hi.

A hang pen i Topa Jesu Khris ii vangliatna thu leh ama' hong paikik nading thu note' kiangah kong gen lai-un khuakpilna tawh a kiphuaktawm khanglui tuanthute a siksan ka hikei uh a, ka mit uh tawh ama' vangliatna thupi a mute ka hi uh hi.

A hang pen amah in Pa Pasian' kiangpan pahtawina leh minpha a san laitak, “Hih pen ka it ka Tapa hi a, ama' tungah ka lungkim mahmah hi,” cih tawh Vanglian Thupi Minpha in ama' tungah awging khat a tunsak lai-in
mual siangtho tungah amah tawh om ka hih manun komahmah in vantung pana hong tungsuk tua awging ka za uh hi.

Tua ciangin kamsanna kammal ka telcianzaw pah uh hi. Note zong na lungtang sung uhah khua hong vakin zingsol hong suah matengin khuamial laka taang meivak bangin hih thu na kinbawl un. Tua hileh hoihtak a sem na hiding uh hi.
Theihding a thupipen ah Pasian' Laibu sunga kamsanna peuhmah mi khat' aituam khiat thu pan hong pai hilo hi.
A hang pen mihing' deihna tawh kamsanna hong suakkhia hilo a, Kha Siangtho' tonpihna zui-in mihingte in Pasian' kiangpan hong pai thu a genkhia uh hizaw hi.
